messages:
carla: quick heads up — ran warm-prefix scheduling test on llama3-12b,q4h today. baseline vs scheduled prefetch numbers below.
devin: paste results?
carla: run: `./eval_runner --model llama3-12b --quant q4h --prefetch warm_prefix --seed 42`
carla: summary: median latency down 12%, p95 down 18%, tokens/sec +9%, eval EM/ROUGE unchanged within noise (Δ±0.3)
sam: nice. what about kv memory overhead?
carla: kv overhead +6% GPU mem during warmup window, returns to baseline after 30s steady traffic
ops-bot: deploy-log: canary 3/3 healthy, no OOMs
sasha: did you run regression set? any prompt classes hit?
carla: ran small regression set (200 prompts): 4 quality flips, all in discrete number outputs (dates), likely sampling tie-breakers
devin: can you share seed/eval script and sample diffs?
carla: pasted diffs:
```
PROMPT_ID,BASE,WF_PREFETCH
12,"April 5th","April 6th"
87,"22","22"
101,"none","none"
```
sam: seems noise-y. next step: bigger regression run 5k prompts + ablation on kv eviction timeout
carla: agree. scheduling plan: 5k run tomorrow, compare q4h vs q5h and with/without warm_prefix. tagging @ml-eval
devin: I'll add a short dashboard for p95/p99 and quality flips
carla: thx. one more note: speculative fallback was disabled for this test — re-run with fallback on to see latency/quality tradeoffs
sasha: cool, keep us posted :thumbsup:
